candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Mini Game Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a centered interactive card with a tip carousel and desktop control shortcuts to keep users engaged during generation.
candidates.why: The home waiting step has an extremely high mean wait time of 2336s and 201s median, causing user drop-off while waiting for pet rendering.

waiting.headline: Your Pet is Coming to Life!
waiting.body: While your companion generates in the background, learn quick desktop controls.

components.text: Tip: Press Alt+P anytime on your desktop to hide or show your pet.

guard.reason: Redesigns the waiting screen while retaining its core function and staying within onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: High mean wait time causes drop-off at home step, but interactive mini-game requires significant code effort.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Quick Controls Guide Screen
candidates.change: Add a new interactive quick controls screen right before home_intro that demonstrates desktop shortcuts, context menus, and hiding features.
candidates.why: Support received multiple tickets from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after finishing onboarding.

new_controls_guide.headline: How to Control Your Desktop Pet
new_controls_guide.body: Master these simple desktop actions before meeting your pet.

components.text: Right-click pet for menu; Drag to move; Alt+P to hide

guard.reason: Adds a valid new guide screen within the onboarding flow without removing any required steps.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has lowest conversion (64.8%) and explicit support tickets, but requires a new guide screen.

candidates.title: Move Story Intro After Path Selection
candidates.change: Reorder the onboarding flow so users pick their pet creation path immediately upon opening the app before viewing the backstory.
candidates.why: The initial choose_path step has a long mean time (514s); letting users take action first boosts momentum before story exposition.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

candidates.title: Live Pet Preview Customization Flow
candidates.change: Replace the standard photo upload area with a live 3D preview component showing instant feedback on uploaded photo features.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or looking wrong; real-time preview lets users adjust photo quality before submitting.

guard.reason: 'upload_photos.replace.photo_upload[0]': a preview cannot do the photo_upload job (use ['button', 'checklist', 'image', 'photo_picker', 'text'])

candidates.title: Existing Account Email Verification Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint banner on the sign-in screen urging returning users to use their original sign-in email to preserve pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in with a different or new account.

sign_in.hint: Signing back in? Make sure to use your original account email so your pet profile is safely restored!

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Estimated Time Countdown on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Display progress and time estimate indicators on the waiting screen with a timer component.
candidates.why: The median waiting time is 201s (mean 2336s); clear progress transparency reduces anxiety and drop-off during rendering.

components.text: Rendering desktop companion model (~2 min remaining)

guard.reason: text in 'waiting.components[0].text' has characters outside the allowed set: ['~']

candidates.title: Clear Path Selection Benefit Headlines
candidates.change: Rewrite headline and body on the choose_path screen to contrast quick ready-to-adopt pets against custom avatar creation.
candidates.why: The mean time on choose_path is 514s, indicating confusion between preset options and custom generation.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Desktop Companion Path
choose_path.body: Choose a fast pre-made companion (30 seconds) or build a unique pet custom generated from your own photos.

guard.reason: Updates copy on choose_path while continuing to offer both pre-made adoption and custom pet creation.

candidates.score_note: Long mean duration on path choice targeted with simple copy changes that can be configured without a new release.

candidates.title: First Companion Accessory Welcome Gift
candidates.change: Display an unlocked starter accessory badge on the final home_intro screen as a completion reward.
candidates.why: The finish step has a drop-off rate of 35.2%; rewarding completion incentivizes finalizing onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Home! Here is Your Free Starter Accessory

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions 'Free Starter Accessory', violating rule 3 which forbids mentioning free extras, gifts, or prices.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Split Layout with Mascot
candidates.change: Switch adoption_certificate screen layout to split view and include a cheerful pet mascot component.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 69.6%; elevating visual celebration reinforces the emotional payoff of adopting a pet.

guard.reason: Redesigns the adoption certificate layout while retaining its official certificate branding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step drops to 69.6%; split layout and visual updates require UI rework.

candidates.title: Sign In Stalling Troubleshooter Button
candidates.change: Add a sign-in troubleshooter action button on the sign_in screen to resolve freeze or webview loading delays.
candidates.why: Support received reports of sign-in screens stalling or failing to load before users could authenticate.

sign_in.body: Sign in to sync your pet and settings across desktop devices.

guard.reason: Adds a troubleshooter button to the sign-in screen without violating any onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in drop-off aligns directly with support reports of webview stalling; action button offers quick recovery.
